theorem_title: The selected-color fast solver has polynomial resource needs
theorem_natural_language_statement:
The complete resource-need function for the selected-color fast 3SUM program satisfies the framework polynomial-need predicate, uniformly in input length and value bound.

This polynomial need result allows the complete selected-color solver to be embedded in the finite color driver.
